title: Old Natchez Compound Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Old Natchez Compound is a large Seaside, Florida home perfect for multiple families or large groups. Just 377 feet to the beach access and across from the pool, this home has expansive porches and amazing outdoor areas to live large!
description_expanded: Description147 GRAYTON STREETMain House Natchez House 4BD: 2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 1 TWIN BUNK, TWIN/TRUNDLE (sleeps 10)Oak Creek Annie & High Creek Rustler's 2BD: 2 QUEENs, QUEEN SLEEPER, DOUBLE (SLEEPS 8)A One-of-a-Kind Seaside Family CompoundWelcome to Old Natchez Compound, a rare and distinguished retreat in the heart of Seaside, Florida. This expansive six-bedroom estate thoughtfully combines the elegance of the Old Natchez Main House with the charm of its guest cottages—Oak Creek Annie’s and High Rustler—to create a seamless coastal compound designed for gathering, entertaining, and unwinding together. Accommodating up to 18 guests, this exceptional property is ideal for extended families, multi-generational vacations, or groups seeking both shared spaces and private escapes.Perfectly positioned on Natchez Street, one of Seaside’s most picturesque avenues, the compound sits on a coveted corner lot directly across from the Westside Pool and just 377 feet from private beach access, placing Seaside’s iconic shoreline and amenities moments from your door.Outdoor Living Designed for GatheringOld Natchez Compound shines with its abundance of outdoor living spaces. Wide, breezy porches wrap the front of both homes, overlooking a beautifully landscaped, fenced yard that feels peaceful yet inviting. Multiple seating areas encourage guests to linger—whether enjoying morning coffee in the shade, relaxing on an upper balcony, or gathering for sunset conversations.At the heart of the compound, a central courtyard connects the homes and creates the perfect space for shared meals and celebrations. A large lighted outdoor dining area comfortably seats the entire group beneath twinkling string lights, while two outdoor charcoal grills make casual cookouts effortless. From quiet mornings to lively evenings, the outdoor spaces set the tone for unforgettable Seaside memories.The Old Natchez Main HouseInside the Main House, timeless coastal design meets modern comfort. The gourmet kitchen, appointed with marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, and custom cabinetry, anchors the home and opens seamlessly to the main living and dining areas. The inviting living room features a large leather sectional and flat-screen TV, ideal for relaxing after beach days, while the dining area seats eight and flows directly to the courtyard for easy indoor-outdoor entertaining.The first-floor primary suite offers a serene retreat with a king bed, ensuite bathroom, and direct porch access—perfect for morning coffee just steps outside. Upstairs, additional sleeping accommodations include a spacious king bedroom with a twin and trundle, opening to a private balcony, a queen suite with ensuite bath and bistro balcony seating, and a charming bunk room with custom built-ins. Each bedroom is thoughtfully appointed with comfortable furnishings, flat-screen TVs, and private touches throughout.Oak Creek Annie’s Guest CottageConnected by the courtyard, Oak Creek Annie’s extends the compound with added flexibility and privacy. The first level features a queen bedroom with an ensuite bath that opens directly to the porch and courtyard—an ideal option for guests who prefer main-level living.Upstairs, guests will find a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy living area with a queen sleeper sofa, and a charming loft with a full bed accessed by a ship’s ladder. A full bathroom with walk-in shower serves this level, while a private balcony with seating for two offers a quiet perch overlooking the compound.High Rustler’s Private RetreatTucked away with its own private entrance, High Rustler is a hidden gem within the compound. This queen suite features an ensuite bath and a Juliette balcony with Gulf views, offering a romantic and peaceful escape above the rooftops of Seaside. Whether enjoying sunrise coffee or sunset skies, this elevated retreat provides one of the most sought-after vantage points in the home.An Elevated Seaside ExperienceTogether, the Main House and guest cottages create an atmosphere that feels both expansive and intimate—offering countless places to gather as a group while preserving privacy when desired. From courtyard dinners and porch lounging to sunset views from upper balconies, Old Natchez Compound delivers a truly effortless Seaside experience.With its prime Natchez Street location, six distinct bedrooms, and exceptional indoor-outdoor living, Old Natchez Compound offers the perfect blend of Southern charm, modern comfort, and timeless coastal style—an unforgettable setting for family reunions, milestone celebrations, or relaxed beach holidays in Seaside, Florida.* 5NT Min. for Spring, Spring Break, and Summer; 3NT Min. for Fall, 2NT. Min. Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. Only the 6BD unit Old Natchez Compound is available for rent during the summer peak season.FEATURES2,583 square feet377 feet to beach access | 2-minute walk to Natchez Pavilion, the largest stretch of private residential beach on 30AOutdoor Living: Lighted outdoor dining areaGrilling: Two charcoal grillsCommunity Amenities Access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote: Two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityGuest Services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Cart Policy: Two parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.Pet Policy: No pets allowed
